typography.displayRole: none — the reference is sans-led at every level and spends nothing on type personality; hierarchy is carried by weight and colour (orange vs near-black vs warm grey), not by a display face
typography.uiRole: one humanist grotesque for everything; semibold for labels and field names, bold for headings and the amount inside the CTA

composition.home: Quiet cream header (brand, location), greeting, a tracking field with the search action attached to it, one primary 'Send a parcel' action, then the active shipment card with its status answered before anything else, then recent shipments as one repeated row module.
composition.detail: Status first, proof second, detail third — the reference's tracking read order: status card with ETA, then the route panel, then address, then the vertical timeline. Identifiers are bold but not the headline.
composition.send: Single column, one decision group per block (package type, weight, addresses, service), one full-width CTA pinned at the bottom of the flow with the live amount inside it.
composition.density: Moderate and even. Form rows are tall; list rows are one repeated module (tint icon chip left, two-line text, chevron right).

grammar.cta: One pill shape, brand fill, white text, and the price disclosed inside the button at the decision point.
grammar.selection: Package type and service are card/pill selections marked by brand outline plus brand fill; weight is a stepper.
grammar.numbers: The quote equals base + per-kg above the included weight, times the service multiplier, and must agree on the form, the confirmation and the shipments list.
grammar.status: Five-stage timeline. Completed = filled brand node with a check; current = filled brand node; upcoming = hollow grey. Terminal 'Delivered' gets a distinct glyph, and 'Cancelled' replaces the timeline with a plain status.
grammar.errors: Inline, under the field, in the error colour, with the field ringed. No modal interruptions.

imagery.role: The reference leads its tracking screens with a map. No map service is available offline, so a stylised route panel stands in: a dark board with an orange-to-ink route line, origin pin, destination pin and vehicle marker. Declared substitution — it encodes progress in the line itself, as the reference does, but it is not a map.
imagery.substitution: Stylised SVG route panel replaces the live map. No photography is used anywhere.

provenance.measured: engine/analyze_image.py on the original file: sat>=0.25 = 15.03%, sat>=0.03 = 94.27%, modal hue bin 20deg (orange), hue family share 97.6% of coloured pixels, ~57% of pixels above luminance 0.7. Independently re-derived by engine/reference_profile.mjs, which recommends neutral-gallery.
provenance.interpreted: Composition, grammar and role assignments are visual interpretation of the full-resolution board (forensics/phase1/R12-swiftgo.md). Font identity is NOT inferred — only the sans role. The five-stage status grammar is taken from the reference's own stepper/timeline screens.
uncertainty: The brand hex is a deliberate darkening of the reference's #F97316-class orange. White text on #F97316 measures 2.80:1, which fails AA; #C2410C measures 5.18:1. The hue is faithful, the lightness is not — recorded here rather than hidden.
The reference ships no error states; the error grammar is extrapolated from its form grammar and is engine-side invention, not reference fidelity.
The map is a stylised substitute, so the reference's most distinctive tracking asset is only partially reproduced.
